title: ICC Trophy Champions
description: Bangladesh defeated Kenya in the final of the ICC Trophy in Malaysia, securing their first-ever World Cup qualification.

title: First World Cup Win vs Pakistan
description: A historic 62-run victory over Pakistan in Northampton, which fast-tracked Bangladesh's path to Test status.

title: Full Test Status Granted
description: Bangladesh became the 10th Test-playing nation after being granted full membership by the ICC.

title: Inaugural Test Match
description: Bangladesh played their first Test match against India in Dhaka. Aminul Islam scored a historic century.

title: First ODI Win at Home
description: Bangladesh defeated India by 15 runs at the Bangabandhu National Stadium, their first ODI win on home soil.

title: First Test Match Victory
description: Bangladesh secured their first-ever Test win by defeating Zimbabwe by 226 runs in Chittagong.

title: The Cardiff Miracle
description: Mohammad Ashraful's century led Bangladesh to a stunning 5-wicket victory over world champions Australia.

title: World Cup Upset vs India
description: A young Bangladesh side defeated India by 5 wickets in Port of Spain, knocking them out of the World Cup.

title: Victory vs South Africa
description: Bangladesh defeated the top-ranked South African side in the Super Eight stage of the 2007 World Cup.

title: Shakib Reaches No. 1
description: Shakib Al Hasan became the first Bangladeshi player to be ranked as the No. 1 ODI all-rounder in the world.

title: First Overseas Test Series Win
description: Bangladesh secured a 2-0 Test series sweep against the West Indies in the Caribbean.

title: Banglawash vs New Zealand
description: Bangladesh completed a historic 4-0 ODI series sweep against New Zealand in Dhaka.

title: Asia Cup Final Appearance
description: Bangladesh reached their first Asia Cup final, narrowly losing to Pakistan by just 2 runs.

title: First Test Double Century
description: Mushfiqur Rahim became the first Bangladeshi to score a double century in Test cricket (200 vs Sri Lanka).

title: World Cup Quarter-Final
description: Bangladesh defeated England to reach the knockout stages of a World Cup for the first time.

title: Series Wins vs Big Three
description: Bangladesh won consecutive ODI series against Pakistan, India, and South Africa at home.

title: First Test Win vs England
description: Mehidy Hasan Miraz's 12 wickets led Bangladesh to a historic Test victory over England in Dhaka.

title: 100th Test Match Victory
description: Bangladesh celebrated their 100th Test match with a victory over Sri Lanka in Colombo.

title: Champions Trophy Semi-Final
description: A record partnership between Shakib and Mahmudullah helped Bangladesh reach the CT semi-finals.

title: First Test Win vs Australia
description: Shakib Al Hasan's 10-wicket haul secured Bangladesh's first-ever Test victory against Australia.

title: Another Asia Cup Final
description: Bangladesh reached the Asia Cup final again, losing to India on the final ball of the match.

title: U19 World Cup Champions
description: Bangladesh won their first-ever ICC global trophy by defeating India in the U19 World Cup final.

title: Historic Test Win in NZ
description: Bangladesh defeated world champions New Zealand in Mount Maunganui, their first win in NZ in any format.

title: T20I Series Sweep vs England
description: Bangladesh completed a 3-0 T20I series whitewash against world champions England.

title: Test Series Sweep in Pakistan
description: Bangladesh secured a historic 2-0 Test series victory in Pakistan, their first-ever series win against them.
